standard.summary: 当 attention 后端解析为 PyTorch SDPA 时，指定优先使用的 kernel：auto（PyTorch 默认调度）、cutlass（efficient attention，默认）、flash、cudnn、math（纯参考实现）。
standard.effect: 训练前向的 SDPA 调用被限定在所选 kernel 上执行；auto 则交给 PyTorch 自行调度。仅在 attention_backend 最终解析为 sdpa 时生效。
standard.whenToUse: 排查数值差异时用 math 做参考基线；特定硬件上 flash 或 cudnn 明显更快时手动固定；默认 cutlass 在多数消费级卡上是稳妥选择。
standard.avoidWhen: attention_backend 是 xformers/sageattn 等非 SDPA 后端时本项不参与；math 后端极慢且费显存，只用于诊断不要用于正式训练。

standard_en.summary: When the attention backend resolves to PyTorch SDPA, this names the kernel to prefer: auto (PyTorch's own dispatch), cutlass (efficient attention, the default), flash, cudnn, or math (the pure reference implementation).
standard_en.effect: The SDPA calls in the training forward pass are confined to the chosen kernel; auto leaves the dispatch to PyTorch. It only takes effect when attention_backend finally resolves to sdpa.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use math as a reference baseline when chasing a numerical difference; pin flash or cudnn by hand when one of them is clearly faster on your hardware; the default cutlass is a safe choice on most consumer cards.
standard_en.avoidWhen: This setting takes no part when attention_backend is a non-SDPA backend such as xformers or sageattn; the math backend is extremely slow and memory-hungry, so use it for diagnosis only, never for real training.

advanced.principle: PyTorch scaled_dot_product_attention 内部有多个实现（FlashAttention-2、memory-efficient/cutlass、cuDNN、math），默认按启发式挑选。固定 kernel 可换取可复现的性能与数值特征——不同 kernel 的浮点归约顺序不同，位级结果不同。
advanced.intervention: runtime_optimizations_attention_plan.py 归一化取值进 RuntimeOptimizationPlan；runtime_optimizations_attention_apply.py 在前向作用域用对应的 sdpa_kernel 上下文限定后端；Apple MPS 运行时被强制为 math。
advanced.expectedImpact: kernel 之间吞吐差异可达 10%~30%（依 shape 与硬件）；对训练质量无影响，只有位级数值差异。
advanced.tradeoffs: 固定 kernel 后若该 kernel 不支持当前 shape/dtype 会报错而不是静默回退；auto 最稳但性能不保证最优。
advanced.codePath: runtime_optimizations_attention_plan.py:_normalize_sdpa_backend_policy；runtime_optimizations_attention_apply.py 应用 sdpa kernel 上下文；configs_performance.py 定义

advanced_en.principle: PyTorch's scaled_dot_product_attention has multiple internal implementations (FlashAttention-2, memory-efficient/cutlass, cuDNN, math), selected by heuristics by default. Pinning a kernel buys reproducible performance and numerics — different kernels use different floating-point reduction orders, so bitwise results differ.
advanced_en.intervention: runtime_optimizations_attention_plan.py normalizes the value into RuntimeOptimizationPlan; runtime_optimizations_attention_apply.py restricts the backend with the matching sdpa_kernel context inside the forward scope; the Apple MPS runtime is forced to math.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Throughput differences between kernels can reach 10%~30% (depending on shape and hardware); no effect on training quality, only bitwise numeric differences.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: With a pinned kernel, if that kernel does not support the current shape/dtype it errors rather than silently falling back; auto is the safest but does not guarantee best performance.
advanced_en.codePath: runtime_optimizations_attention_plan.py:_normalize_sdpa_backend_policy; runtime_optimizations_attention_apply.py applies the sdpa kernel context; defined in configs_performance.py
